thesis: The site's primary conversion mechanism is the coverage check, which appears as the dominant CTA across the homepage and plans pages, but its effectiveness is diluted by multiple competing CTAs and a duplicated plans page that splits the funnel. The most valuable fix is to consolidate the plans pages and streamline the coverage check into a single, unambiguous path, while reinforcing trust signals (testimonials, guarantees, badges) at the decision point to recover lost conversions.

findings.title: Credibility badges not near CTAs
findings.summary: Media logos appear only on homepage, not near CTAs on other pages.
findings.problem: Media logos appear only on homepage, not near CTAs on other pages.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Place badges adjacent to CTAs on subpages
findings.evidence: h2: As Featured In: | ctas: CHECK COVERAGE | SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR | CHECK MY COVERAGE
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Weak page metadata
findings.summary: Search and social previews are degraded: page title, meta description, Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths.
findings.problem: Search and social previews are degraded: page title, meta description, Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Write a 15-60 char title and 70-160 char description per page; add og:title and og:image for link previews.
findings.evidence: Measured on the homepage: title 9 chars (15-60 recommended); description 0 chars (70-160 recommended); og:title missing, og:image missing.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Duplicate plans pages split funnel
findings.summary: Two URLs serve identical plans content, splitting the conversion path and confusing users about which is canonical.
findings.problem: Two URLs serve identical plans content, splitting the conversion path and confusing users about which is canonical.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; notes: Consolidate to one canonical URL and redirect the other
findings.evidence: PAGE /pages/plans | PAGE /plans | h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet | h2: The Fastest Rural & On-the-Go Internet in the USA
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Social proof absent on plans page
findings.summary: Plans page lacks testimonials that appear elsewhere, missing trust at decision point.
findings.problem: Plans page lacks testimonials that appear elsewhere, missing trust at decision point.

findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Coverage check appears twice in funnel
findings.summary: Coverage check CTA appears on both homepage and plans page, forcing users to repeat a step.
findings.problem: Coverage check CTA appears on both homepage and plans page, forcing users to repeat a step.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Remove redundant coverage check from plans page; notes: Carry result forward

findings.title: Images missing alternative text
findings.summary: 13 of 125 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and the image-search traffic the alt text earns.
findings.problem: 13 of 125 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and the image-search traffic the alt text earns.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add descriptive alt text; use alt="" only for decorative images.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 13 of 125 elements have no alt attribute.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
